examples.text: Elle a appelé tandis que j'étais sorti.
examples.en: She called while I was out.

examples.text: On devrait beaucoup lire tandis qu'on est jeune.
examples.en: While you're young, you should read a lot.
She interrupted him while he was speaking.

examples.text: Ne m'interromps pas tandis que je parle.
examples.en: Don't interrupt me while I'm speaking.

examples.text: Ne lui parlez pas tandis qu'il étudie.
examples.en: Don't talk to him while he's studying.
